"Double The Money" has gone three months without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About half of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $100,000 prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

Tomorrow's count on "Double The Money" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2415.headline: Three months, no top prize claimed

2416.body:
"Loaded with $2,000s" has 57,973 prizes of $20 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $500 prize, with 968 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

Tomorrow's count on "Loaded with $2,000s" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2416.headline: Prize table details

2419.body:
The most common win left on "Bronze 7s" is $1. The second biggest prize left is $250, and eleven of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

Everything here about "Bronze 7s" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 27.
2419.headline: Prize table details

2420.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Silver 7s", about half are still unsold. The game is about halfway through its run, with two of three top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

If "Silver 7s" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2420.headline: Tickets sold so far

2421.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Gold 7s", about two-thirds are still unsold. The game is about halfway through its run, with one of three top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

If you play "Gold 7s" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2421.headline: Tickets sold so far

2422.body:
"Platinum 7s" has two of three top prizes left and is near the midpoint of its run. About half of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

The second-biggest prize left on "Platinum 7s" is $70,000, with two of them remaining.

The numbers for "Platinum 7s" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
2422.headline: How much has sold

2425.body:
"$1,000,000 Crossword Gems" has joined the Virginia lineup at $20 with three top prizes of $1 million. On the first day every prize is still in the game, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

Every line of $1,000,000 Crossword Gems's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2425.headline: A brand-new game to watch

2426.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "HAUNTED HUNDREDS", about a third are still unsold. The game is in the second half of its run, with 1,851 of 5,340 top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

If "HAUNTED HUNDREDS" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2426.headline: How much has sold

2427.body:
"HOLIDAY TRIPLER" is near the start of its run, with about three-quarters of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

The numbers for "HOLIDAY TRIPLER" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2427.headline: Where this game is in its run

2428.body:
"PEPPERMINT PAYOUT" is still new, with about three-quarters of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

Everything above about "PEPPERMINT PAYOUT" comes from the Virginia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2428.headline: How far along this game is

2429.body:
"MERRY MONEY TREE" has fewer top prizes left. The count changed when one top prize of $125,000 was claimed over a week ago. Unsold tickets still hold three of the original four. Check the top prize count first when you compare scratchers.

If you play "MERRY MONEY TREE" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2429.headline: Fewer $125,000 prizes left

2430.body:
"WRAPPED IN RICHES" has had no $500,000 top prize claimed since we started watching it. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

The numbers for "WRAPPED IN RICHES" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2430.headline: Top prizes are still unclaimed

2431.body:
"2027" is new from the Virginia Lottery. It is a $1 game with four top prizes of $2,027. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Everything above about "2027" comes from the Virginia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2431.headline: A new game is here

2433.body:
"Black Ice" is new from the Virginia Lottery. It is a $10 game with three top prizes of $500,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Everything here about "Black Ice" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 27.
2433.headline: Brand new, no claims yet

2434.body:
"Loaded with $250s" just reached Virginia stores with 11,082 top prizes of $250. A new game is the easiest kind to judge. No prizes have been claimed, so every prize level is still full. Every day of sales changes that, and this page tracks it.

Everything here about "Loaded with $250s" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 27.
2434.headline: New game, all prizes left
